hotels.title: Secluded Playa del Carmen Beachfront Sanctuary near Cancun with 10 Restaurants & Bars & Six Pools
hotels.description: Tucked away along Mexico's Riviera Maya, this five-star jungle escape is wrapped in tropical splendour. Fairmont Mayakoba boasts elegant rooms and private casitas scattered along winding lagoons and sugar-sand beaches, surrounded by 595 acres of tropical jungle. Dive into five shimmering pools, unwind at the Mayan-inspired Fairmont Spa or play 18 holes at the prestigious El Camaleón golf course. Your taste buds are in for a treat with four gourmet restaurants serving everything from Mexican flavours to Korean BBQ. Minutes from Playa del Carmen and surrounded by ancient Mayan wonders, the resort offers endless opportunities for adventure, from snorkelling colourful coral reefs to ziplining through lush jungle canopies.
